description: Mediary Scout versions prior to 2026.11.05 have a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows any authenticated user, including those without ownership privileges, to set an arbitrary PanSou base URL without proper role verification. Exploitation enables attackers to send server-side POST requests to internal hosts and use error responses to discover internal hosts and ports.
